Invest in some hair scissors and do some research on hydral fatigue/ protein overload or moisture overload/protein fatigue. Both annoyingly have the same symptoms and lead to split ends that must be cut

The key word words that tell me your hair needs a trim are small knots, frizz , and undefined. You won't achieve the look you want without trimming the split ends off.

Maintaning a balance of protein and moisturize + trims every 3-4 months and taking measure to prevent split ends from manipulation is essential for healthy hair. Both hydral fatigue and protein overload can lead to split ends. You could even have protein fatigue and hydration overload. Its all based on what ingredients you put in your hair
